newsitem.title: UK: Retailers queue up to buy Littlewoods - paper.
newsitem.headline: Retailers queue up to buy Littlewoods - paper.

text.p: About a dozen retailers, including the main British supermarket groups, are believed to have entered the running to buy Littlewoods ' chain of 135 high street stores, the Times newspaper said on Wednesday.
Littlewoods, Britain's largest private company, said earlier in the month it was putting the chain on the market in order to focus on its mail order and leisure businesses.

Property companies have been excluded from the sale, which is expected to raise more than 500 million stg ($808 million), and sales memoranda were sent to companies including ASDA Group Plc, Tesco Plc and Marks & Spencer Plc, the newspaper said.
Potential buyers are expected to come back with firm offers in about six weeks, the newspaper said. ($1=.6188 Stg)
